command:
set -eu
umask 077
root_user="infra$(openssl rand -hex 8)"
root_pass="$(openssl rand -base64 36 | tr -d '\n' | tr '/+' '_-')"
sudo sh -c 'umask 077; printf "MINIO_ROOT_USER=%s\nMINIO_ROOT_PASSWORD=[REDACTED] "$1" "$2" > /etc/minio/minio.env' sh "$root_user" "$root_pass"
tmpcfg=$(mktemp)
cat > "$tmpcfg" <<'EOF'
[req]
distinguished_name = dn
x509_extensions = v3_req
prompt = no
[dn]
CN = minio.internal
O = InfraSet
[v3_req]
keyUsage = critical,digitalSignature,keyEncipherment
extendedKeyUsage = serverAuth
subjectAltName = @alt_names
[alt_names]
DNS.1 = node1
DNS.2 = node2
DNS.3 = node3
DNS.4 = node4
DNS.5 = minio.internal
IP.1 = 10.100.5.10
IP.2 = 10.100.5.11
IP.3 = 10.100.5.12
IP.4 = 10.100.5.13
EOF
sudo openssl req -x509 -nodes -newkey rsa:3072 -days 825 -config "$tmpcfg" -keyout /etc/minio/certs/private.key -out /etc/minio/certs/public.crt >/dev/null 2>&1
rm -f "$tmpcfg"
sudo chown root:minio-user /etc/minio/minio.env /etc/minio/certs/private.key /etc/minio/certs/public.crt
sudo chmod 0640 /etc/minio/minio.env /etc/minio/certs/private.key
sudo chmod 0644 /etc/minio/certs/public.crt
for n in node2 node3 node4; do
  sudo scp -q /etc/minio/minio.env "root@$n:/etc/minio/minio.env"
  sudo scp -q /etc/minio/certs/public.crt /etc/minio/certs/private.key "root@$n:/etc/minio/certs/"
  sudo ssh "root@$n" 'chown root:minio-user /etc/minio/minio.env /etc/minio/certs/private.key /etc/minio/certs/public.crt; chmod 0640 /etc/minio/minio.env /etc/minio/certs/private.key; chmod 0644 /etc/minio/certs/public.crt'
done
printf 'credential_files_distributed=yes\n'
sudo openssl x509 -in /etc/minio/certs/public.crt -noout -subject -ext subjectAltName | sed -n '1,4p'
